subject: ela
intro: Pick how the characters are the same or different.

items.prompt:
A red bird and a blue bird can both fly. They are the SAME because:
A) Both can fly
B) Different colors
C) Both are red

steps: Alike: both fly. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A cat has fur and a fish has scales. They are DIFFERENT because:
A) Both swim
B) One has fur, one has scales
C) Both are pets
items.answer: B) One has fur, one has scales

solution.answer: B) One has fur, one has scales

items.prompt:
A frog hops and a rabbit hops. They are the SAME because:
A) Both hop
B) Both swim
C) Both roar

One dog is big and one is small, but both like to run. One way they are the SAME:
A) Both are big
B) Both like to run
C) Both are small

A lion roars and a mouse squeaks. They are DIFFERENT because:
A) Both are animals
B) They make different sounds
C) Both have fur

steps: Roar vs squeak. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Two owls both fly at night. They are the SAME because:
A) One flies, one walks
B) Both fly at night
C) Different colors

A turtle moves slowly and a rabbit moves fast, but both race. What is DIFFERENT?
A) Both race
B) Their speed
C) Both are animals

steps: Slow vs fast. Key is B.

items.prompt:
One hero saves a cat and another saves a dog. What is the SAME about them?
A) Both save an animal
B) One saves a cat only
C) They are different

steps: Shared action: saving an animal. Key is A.
